title: The wave 4 cutover reconciliation harness pack for money and closure is not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 §R7.2 and §R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 15, 16 and 44; legacy RWB-DM-013 section 2, section 15 and the note under its Endpoints table
section: 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: No source read gives the harness environment and its base hosts, the cutover extract fixture and its field layout, the reconciliation extract format and its break-list fields, the evidence format and retention, the pass or fail gate, or the synthetic data set. ownership.json gives the owners and the operations only: rwb-source-data for DP13, DP01, DP02, the freshness read and the JOB-04 rerun, rwb-payment for the proceeds match, rwb-case for the closure, rwb-decision for the decision log and rwb-access for the caller's rights. The legacy story states only that the migration is a cutover step run by the recovery service identity and that its breaks are listed on the reconciliation extract, and that there is no endpoint in the story.
evidence: No source read gives these values; ownership.json gives the owners and operations only, and the legacy story says the migration is a cutover step with no endpoint

title: The retention period, the closure evidence pack and the synthetic clock for the retention close are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 §R7.2 and §R9; Program BRD v4 NFR-031 (retention Not set, open under DL26), NFR-028, NFR-072 and NFR-074; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 20, 41 and 44; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slide 23; legacy RWB-E6-025 sections Data, Endpoints and Test cases
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: NFR-031 leaves the case retention period Not set under DL26, so the period the retention timer runs on has no approved value in the sources. No source read either gives the harness environment and its base hosts, the synthetic clock mechanism and the fixture dates that drive the placement and retention expiries, the shape of the retention evidence, the evidence format and retention, the pass or fail gate, or the synthetic case and document keys. ownership.json gives the owners and the operations only: rwb-case for the case and its timers, rwb-document for the documents and their retention class, rwb-source-data for DP13 with the freshness read, rwb-decision for the ledger and rwb-access for the caller's rights, and it publishes no retention operation and no write-off read operation.
evidence: NFR-031 records the retention period as Not set (open under DL26); no source read gives the clock fixture, the evidence shape or the gate
proposed: Set the retention period under DL26 before the wave 4 entry check; until then hold the period as a reference value in the fixture, and agree the clock mechanism, the evidence shape and the gate with Compliance and the integration lead
